description:
Bill of materials for crnk-framework-lts artifacts. Unlike the original Gradle build (which derived this
    list automatically from all subprojects via a pom.withXml hook), Maven has no equivalent - this list is
    hand-maintained and must be updated whenever a module is added to or removed from the root pom.xml's
    <modules> list. Currently trimmed to only the modules published so far (the Maven Central
    publishing trial); expand as the rest of the library is published.
